title: Clamp safety grounding lead to enclosure busbar before pulling ceramic fuse carrier
instruction: Remove the ceramic fuse carrier from the distribution panel and place it in the parts tray.
context: Electricians (BLS SOC 47-2111; 762,600 US jobs, BLS OEWS May 2023) and Electrical and Electronics Repairers, Powerhouse and Substation (SOC 49-2095; 23,400 US jobs) service commercial air conditioning disconnect boxes and distribution panels (such as Eaton/Square D 60A fused pull-out disconnects, ~$35 off-the-shelf). Under OSHA 1910.269(n) and NFPA 70E §120.5 personal protective grounding mandates, de-energized distribution busbars can carry hazardous induced capacitive charge or backfeed voltage. Before withdrawing the high-voltage ceramic fuse carrier from its spring-clip receiver, the technician must attach a spring-loaded bronze grounding clamp jaw onto the exposed copper ground busbar tab. Attempting to pull the fuse without equipotential grounding trips the safety interlock (immediate 0.0 fail). After grounding, the worker extracts the fuse carrier and places it into the parts tray.
setup: Commercial fused disconnect enclosure at x 22 cm, y 0 cm, with copper ground busbar tab on mounting shelf at x 22 cm, y +9.5 cm, and central ceramic pull-out fuse carrier seated in spring clips. Bronze grounding clamp with grip sits at x 18 cm, y +20 cm. Molded parts safety tray sits at x 22 cm, y -18 cm.
scoring: Score 1.0 when clamp jaw is clamped onto busbar tab (dr <= 40 mm, dz <= 40 mm), fuse carrier placed into safety tray (dr <= 80 mm, dz <= 35 mm), hands clear >= 35 mm, and held stationary for 0.75 s. Partial: 0.20 clamp lifted; 0.50 clamp grounded; 0.75 fuse extracted safely. Fail (0.0): pulling fuse before clamp grounded (tripping hazard), or dropped.
reset_notes: Place disconnect enclosure at x 0.22 m, y 0.00 m. Place grounding clamp at x 0.18 m, y +0.20 m. Place safety parts tray at x 0.22 m, y -0.18 m.
fidelity: Commercial NEMA 3R 60A disconnect box (140x180x80 mm steel enclosure, 1.2 kg) with 6 mm copper busbar tab. Bronze spring grounding clamp (45g, stable 50x40 mm base). Ceramic pull-out fuse carrier (40g, dual contact blades). Molded anti-static safety tray (140x110 mm, 0.25 kg). 100% dynamic rigid contact physics, zero synthetic teleportation.
